entries.subject: V15 gate rows: SIGNED_OFF_PENDING_HARDWARE_CONFIRMATION cannot resolve executionEligible under the frozen C4 GateResolver
entries.text: WORKER.md and approved_task.json direct: seed gate_registry V15 rows with sign_off_state=SIGNED_OFF_PENDING_HARDWARE_CONFIRMATION, and write a resolver test asserting both cp_inventory_collect and pan_inventory_collect resolve executionEligible=true with no AMBIGUOUS_GATE_RESOLUTION (AC-1, AC-4). I read the frozen C4 implementation before touching anything: GateResolver.resolve (ui2/capability-registry/.../GateResolver.java) returns GateResolution.Unknown for ANY sign_off_state other than SIGNED_OFF -- its own javadoc names SIGNED_OFF_PENDING_HARDWARE_CONFIRMATION as the canonical example of a state that resolves UNKNOWN (C4 section 3.3 step 5). GateResolution.executionEligible() is true only for Known or NotApplicable, never Unknown. So a gate row with sign_off_state=SIGNED_OFF_PENDING_HARDWARE_CONFIRMATION structurally makes its step ineligible, and CapabilityRegistryLoader ANDs step eligibility across all steps -- the capability cannot resolve executionEligible under this sign_off_state. This is not a bug to fix quietly: GateResolver/GateResolution/GateRow enforce C4 section 3.3 step 5 as FROZEN contract law, and the task's own status-line text for the gate entries documents ('BINDINGS UNVERIFIED UNTIL THE FIRST LIVE RUN') plus DEVICE_FIRST_CONTACT_COMMAND_GATE_ENTRIES.md's own precedent both read as intentionally unverified-but-approved, which is exactly the state the frozen resolver treats as not-yet-executable. I am stopping here per AGENTS.md authority hierarchy (never silently reconcile a level-2 FROZEN contract against this packet) and the packet's own requirement to raise a RELAY_QUESTION and stop rather than relax the closed-set test or the resolver's frozen semantics. Question: for AC-1/AC-4 to be satisfiable, do you want (a) sign_off_state=SIGNED_OFF instead of SIGNED_OFF_PENDING_HARDWARE_CONFIRMATION on the V15 rows -- i.e. the PO's in-session command-level approval today is treated as the sign-off itself, with bindings-unverified expressed only in the gate entries documents' prose and gate row source_document_pointer, not in sign_off_state; or (b) keep SIGNED_OFF_PENDING_HARDWARE_CONFIRMATION and drop AC-1/AC-4's executionEligible requirement (i.e. inventory stays admission-ineligible until a follow-up movement flips sign-off after the first live run reports counts), which would mean 'Collect now' does not actually go live this movement despite the objective text; or (c) something else you intend that I have not construed. No implementation has been touched pending your answer -- I want your decision before writing the gate documents, migration, or capability YAML so I do not have to redo them.
